zh: 同样是企业AI落地，有的报价呢，
en: For the same enterprise AI implementation, some quotes

zh: 让人觉得便宜，有的又高得你连该问什么都不知道。
en: feel cheap, while others are so high you do not even know what to ask.

zh: 所以呢，很多老板问的不是AI能不能用，
en: Many business owners are not asking whether AI works,

zh: 是这个东西到底值不值。
en: but whether it is worth the money.

zh: 前几天呢，我跟一位做餐饮运营的负责人聊天呢，
en: A few days ago, I spoke with a restaurant operations manager.

zh: 他没有跟我聊什么大模型，
en: He did not talk about large models,

zh: 啊，也没有问我哪个软件最厉害，
en: nor ask which software was the most powerful.

zh: 他讲的呢，都是每天在店里遇到的麻烦。
en: He described the problems stores face every day.

zh: 昨天几十家店的数据要看，
en: Data from dozens of stores had to be checked yesterday.

zh: 上周的数据要对，去年同期也得翻，
en: Last week's data and last year's same period also had to be compared.

zh: 销售卖了多少，后端用了多少，
en: How much was sold, and how much was used at the back end?

zh: 库存还剩多少，东西散在好几个地方，
en: How much inventory remains? The information sits in several places.

zh: 外面同行上了什么新品，做了什么活动都得盯着。
en: New products and campaigns from competitors also need watching.

zh: 每天的信息太多，真正呢，
en: There is too much information every day.

zh: 要到做事的时候呢，嗯，还是不知道先看什么，
en: Yet when it is time to act, you still do not know what to check first,

zh: 先动什么。
en: or what to do first.

zh: 这么一聊呀，我就觉得很多企业一上AI的时候呢，
en: That conversation showed me why many companies get AI wrong at the start.

zh: 方向就拧错了。
en: They begin in the wrong direction.

zh: 大家先问买什么工具，先问要花多少钱，
en: They first ask which tool to buy and how much it costs.

zh: 可是一件事情本身都没理清，AI
en: But if the work itself is still unclear,

zh: 塞进去往往只是多了一个界面。
en: adding AI merely adds another interface.

zh: 所以呢，企业AI呢，真正的差别，
en: The real difference in enterprise AI

zh: 呃，不是在工具的名字上，
en: is not the tool's name,

zh: 在它能不能帮你把一段活接起来。
en: but whether it can connect a whole piece of work.

zh: 什么是一段活啊？
en: What does one piece of work mean?

zh: 就拿咱，咱们餐饮啊最简单的一个情况说，
en: Take a simple restaurant operation.

zh: 要看门店的经营，啊，到底哪些数据要看，
en: To understand store performance, which data must be checked?

zh: 从哪里拿，啊，谁来整理，
en: Where does it come from, and who organizes it?

zh: 看完以后呢，谁来判断，判断完之后是补货呢，
en: Who judges it after review? Should stock be replenished,

zh: 是查损耗，还是先动手，啊，
en: loss investigated, or should action start?

zh: 做完以后呢，这个判断到底对不对？
en: After execution, was the judgment right?

zh: 下一次还要不要继续这么做。
en: Should the same approach be used next time?

zh: 把这一段顺下来之后呢，才知道AI该放在哪。AI
en: Only after this chain is clear do you know where AI belongs.

zh: 呢，可以先帮你把散着的东西呢收回来，
en: AI can first bring scattered information together,

zh: 啊，分一分，比一比，把这些异常的东西呢标出来。
en: sort and compare it, then flag anomalies.

zh: 啊，以前人，要人盯半天的这些表格呢，
en: People used to stare at spreadsheets for hours.

zh: 现在呢，先让它给你做一个提醒，
en: Now AI can give an initial alert.

zh: 但补不补货，怎么处理，谁去执行，
en: But whether to replenish, how to respond, and who executes

zh: 这些事呢，不能让AI自己拍板。
en: must not be decided by AI alone.

zh: 因为呢，到了缺货、压货、啊，
en: Because shortages and excess stock,

zh: 做错活动的时候呢，最后还是店里的人承担。
en: or a wrong campaign are still borne by the store team.

zh: 所以企业用AI呢，不一定非要从大的系统开始，
en: Enterprise AI does not have to begin with a large system.

zh: 啊，先把一段每天都在重复又总是容易错乱的信息整理起来，
en: First organize one recurring information stream that often becomes chaotic.

zh: 就已经很有用了。
en: That alone can already help.

zh: 我自己做视频内容的时候呢，
en: I went through the same process with my video content.

zh: 也是这么过来的。
en: This is how it happened.

zh: 最早呢，我刷信息就是刷到什么看什么，
en: At first, I consumed whatever information appeared.

zh: 啊，今天看一个博主，明天看一个热点，
en: One creator today, one trend tomorrow,

zh: 啊，最后收藏了一堆。
en: and eventually a pile of saved posts.

zh: 真正做内容的时候呢，还是不知道哪些能用。
en: When it was time to make content, I still did not know what was useful.

zh: 后来呢，我才慢慢地给自己定，
en: Later, I began setting my own rules:

zh: 啊，哪些来源是我需要长期看的，
en: which sources deserve long-term attention,

zh: 信息回来以后怎么筛选，什么东西只是热闹，
en: how incoming information should be filtered, and what is only noise,

zh: 什么东西跟我现在做的事有关，
en: versus what relates to my current work

zh: 值得留下来再拆。
en: and deserves deeper analysis.

zh: 我现在呢，做的这个信息获取作战平台，
en: My information acquisition operations platform

zh: 啊，就是要把关注的，呃，
en: first organizes the sources I follow,

zh: 来源先放好，啊，然后呢，
en: then puts those sources in place,

zh: 把每天的信息收回来筛一遍，
en: brings back daily information and filters it,

zh: 呃，留下真正可以用得上，
en: keeping what may actually be useful.

zh: 等我做选题、做项目，跟企业聊问题的时候呢，
en: When I plan topics, run projects, or discuss problems with companies,

zh: 再回头去找，啊，不用每次从头翻。
en: I can retrieve it instead of starting from scratch.

zh: 这套方法呢，放到企业里其实也是一样。
en: The same method applies inside a company.

zh: 如果你是做餐饮的话，呃，
en: If you run restaurants,

zh: 咱们就看跟餐饮，餐饮相关的信息。
en: watch information relevant to restaurants.

zh: 啊，你是做零售的呢，还是做服务的，
en: If you run retail or services,

zh: 啊，呃，就盯着跟自己有生意关系的这些信号。
en: focus on signals related to your own business.

zh: 但是有一点啊，需要特别注意，
en: But one point needs special attention:

zh: 就是看到外面一个菜火了，
en: seeing a dish become popular elsewhere

zh: 不等于明天就照着上，它只是一个信号，
en: does not mean copying it tomorrow; it is only a signal.

zh: 你还得看自己的客人吃不吃，
en: You still need to know whether your customers will eat it,

zh: 啊，成本能不能扛，货能不能跟上，
en: whether margins and supply can support it,

zh: 店里做出来稳不稳定，能不能先小范围试一试，
en: whether the store can make it consistently and run a small test,

zh: 再看数据和反馈。AI
en: before looking at data and feedback.

zh: 呢，先帮你把该看的东西收回来分一分，
en: AI can collect, sort, and remind you.

zh: 提个醒，真正要不要做，还是得回到自己的生意里。
en: The decision still has to return to your own business.

zh: 所以企业呢，AI报价为什么会让人看不明白？
en: So why are enterprise AI quotes so hard to understand?

zh: 啊，因为有的只是给你一个工具，
en: Some only give you a tool.

zh: 有的呢，要碰资料怎么整理，
en: Others must handle how materials are organized,

zh: 啊，信息怎么接，谁来确认，
en: how information is connected and who confirms it,

zh: 最后怎么对结果。
en: and how results are evaluated.

zh: 这不是说贵一点就一定好，
en: This does not mean a higher price is always better.

zh: 而是你得先搞清楚你花的钱到底是买一个界面呢，
en: You first need to know whether you are buying an interface,

zh: 还是有人陪你把一段每天的信息拖住的活慢慢地理顺。
en: or help to untangle a daily workflow blocked by information.

zh: 这不是说啊，贵的一定好，
en: Again, expensive does not automatically mean good.

zh: 而是你先搞明白你花的钱到底是买一个界面的，
en: First work out whether your money buys an interface,

zh: 还是有人陪你把一段每天被信息拖住的活慢慢理顺。
en: or someone who helps untangle that blocked daily workflow.

zh: 我现在做的事情也不是一上来就给企业塞一堆工具，
en: I do not start by stuffing companies with tools.

zh: 我先看看企业每天到底被哪一堆信息拖住了，
en: I first look at which information overload slows the company down.

zh: 先把一个点理明白，跑一跑，
en: Clarify one point and run a small test,

zh: 再决定后面要不要继续做。
en: then decide whether to continue.

zh: 我把自己现在用的这套轻量版行业信息获取工具包整理好了，
en: I have organized my lightweight industry information toolkit.

zh: 然后呢，免费地开源给需要的老板。
en: It will be open-sourced free to business owners who need it.

zh: 餐饮、零售还是做服务，啊，
en: Restaurants, retail, and services

zh: 都可以按自己的行业改。
en: can adapt it to their own industry.

zh: 它不替你做决定，可以先帮你把每天该看什么，
en: It does not decide for you; it helps organize what to watch each day,

zh: 怎么选，看完怎么用理出来。
en: how to filter it, and how to use it.

zh: 评论区留信息，我把这套轻量版整理好，
en: Comment “信息”; I have organized the toolkit

zh: 免费发给大家。
en: and will share it for free.

zh: 我是超哥，在兰州继续把AI放回真实的工作里。
en: I am Chao Ge in Lanzhou, continuing to bring AI back to real work.
